name: GLEAMviz (Global Epidemic and Mobility Model)
description: Client-server epidemic simulation platform that integrates global air travel data, urban commuting patterns, and stochastic compartmental epidemic models to simulate disease spread at worldwide scale. Developed by ISI Foundation and Northeastern University. Used for COVID-19 pandemic forecasting, influenza spread modeling, and public health policy analysis. Provides a visualization interface for exploring emergent global epidemic trajectories.
reputation: Widely cited global epidemic modeling platform; used in WHO and CDC policy contexts
notes: Free to use with registration. Combines metapopulation modeling with stochastic transmission dynamics. Validated against H1N1 2009 and subsequent outbreaks.
